lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns of 3 to 5 nodes, concentrated posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a distinct rectangular grid pattern along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with a high-intensity dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.
